changelog: Consolidated Model Tiers: Grouped Gemini Flash High/Medium/Low into a single clean card with interactive mode selector chips and Active status indicator.
Smart LLM Manager: Full task-to-model routing for Architecture, Coding, Fast Q&A, and Shell tasks, with automatic Claude quota defense.
Network Interruption Recovery & Auto-Retry: Offline task recorder automatically captures pending turns when internet drops and resumes with Gemini on reconnection.
Account Profile Sign-In Card: Clean Sign In prompt in drawer when not authenticated, eliminating fallback user profiles.
Unified Theme Gallery: Streamlined appearance settings with 3 clean display modes (Auto, Dark, Light) and unified multi-mode themes.
Optimized Voice & Dictation: Single dynamic microphone button for live speech-to-text with active listening state indicator.
